Ginger tea ` [Highlight start] can help ease hangover nausea and provide fluids, though it does not cure a hangover or speed up alcohol removal from your body [Highlight end] ` . Time, rest, and rehydration remain the main ways a hangover resolves.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1_qufAnEnRbgEjNU4Gi5tks39Z-G6K9hERtq6B5vbhMiIScJv4CaqBzWyP7avTJnphs_8P8Q4pDCmYCtY16M9Z0TUf3wRTXfIFEOMQYKfOhkrAn4M840v-oNB4dGty_Hb3W-Flo_06N0I4BqQKX0z2z1AihK1Wc-VGUXWrDEARyU1hx1GGSBTENDyvktvxfpoSXIdA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF149Rw1ys4EDcTf2YbEVOJPPye7-F-PYjdh0H7cO-uXGiFHzwgIkzAwUzsqyjq7AH327JoNohgnEYKHWdwGwz2a6UyOLm7FVbfxcUVZOjRwrnF5bdHRpfdSDN9m15H-gGrwVJCpmAqQj0b8nMcL0EOs4u9Slf6Nut8-pLlxsTLpPe8x9d)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF129hXvJduI5eoMIIzfoR2dkYqeULa93xwWFupHOoU4DnnrvQeh2UsMqktd15u_ldaHA8LF9XMEjx11zimSz5WR4w5e6uIK_v1KrlmxicE1edMzusRESMi9pVW9so0Ivq4E6-OBHDt9ywXY8NYyPMkgMiNc0MlmhBdsC462AiUbcnxmqYYETjc8sN94njZOfUWpEPK_agFYxeWyzNXg)

### What Ginger Tea Can Do

- **Soothe nausea:** Ginger acts on the digestive tract and is commonly used to calm stomach upset and nausea, though clinical evidence specifically for hangover nausea is limited.
- **Support hydration:** Sipping warm tea helps replace fluids lost from alcohol's diuretic effect.
- **Ease mild discomfort:** Its anti-inflammatory compounds may offer mild relief for general stomach irritation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF149Rw1ys4EDcTf2YbEVOJPPye7-F-PYjdh0H7cO-uXGiFHzwgIkzAwUzsqyjq7AH327JoNohgnEYKHWdwGwz2a6UyOLm7FVbfxcUVZOjRwrnF5bdHRpfdSDN9m15H-gGrwVJCpmAqQj0b8nMcL0EOs4u9Slf6Nut8-pLlxsTLpPe8x9d)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF129hXvJduI5eoMIIzfoR2dkYqeULa93xwWFupHOoU4DnnrvQeh2UsMqktd15u_ldaHA8LF9XMEjx11zimSz5WR4w5e6uIK_v1KrlmxicE1edMzusRESMi9pVW9so0Ivq4E6-OBHDt9ywXY8NYyPMkgMiNc0MlmhBdsC462AiUbcnxmqYYETjc8sN94njZOfUWpEPK_agFYxeWyzNXg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1_qufAnEnRbgEjNU4Gi5tks39Z-G6K9hERtq6B5vbhMiIScJv4CaqBzWyP7avTJnphs_8P8Q4pDCmYCtY16M9Z0TUf3wRTXfIFEOMQYKfOhkrAn4M840v-oNB4dGty_Hb3W-Flo_06N0I4BqQKX0z2z1AihK1Wc-VGUXWrDEARyU1hx1GGSBTENDyvktvxfpoSXIdA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF1xYPSGZSvD98Pv11YxWvg9X9tZy6kW-RtjHqJLnB6ws6x0Sphw3PUGyJXii4caAeV7ms9mTSlIAYmtlk9CY7ZWKfG9fK7_VNSsx7YjNXDPC1_sij53Q0dRruvKGGl_B1IuqTO7R5cRoGwFp9TF0UANOc8Y3g4Dtbp6MQsjbNYXoLGBqIH4RENvf6o4-HGgi4_d2xmWUVia7FAbs)

### How to Make a Basic Cup

- Steep 5–6 slices of fresh ginger root (or about 1 teaspoon of ginger) in hot water for around 10 minutes.
- Add a small squeeze of lemon or a touch of honey if your stomach tolerates it.
- Sip slowly alongside bland foods like toast or crackers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF149Rw1ys4EDcTf2YbEVOJPPye7-F-PYjdh0H7cO-uXGiFHzwgIkzAwUzsqyjq7AH327JoNohgnEYKHWdwGwz2a6UyOLm7FVbfxcUVZOjRwrnF5bdHRpfdSDN9m15H-gGrwVJCpmAqQj0b8nMcL0EOs4u9Slf6Nut8-pLlxsTLpPe8x9d)

### Things to Keep in Mind

- **Stomach irritation:** Ginger can trigger heartburn, acid reflux, or stomach discomfort—especially on an already irritated stomach after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF129hXvJduI5eoMIIzfoR2dkYqeULa93xwWFupHOoU4DnnrvQeh2UsMqktd15u_ldaHA8LF9XMEjx11zimSz5WR4w5e6uIK_v1KrlmxicE1edMzusRESMi9pVW9so0Ivq4E6-OBHDt9ywXY8NYyPMkgMiNc0MlmhBdsC462AiUbcnxmqYYETjc8sN94njZOfUWpEPK_agFYxeWyzNXg)
- **Pain relievers:** If you also take medication for a headache, avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) around alcohol use due to liver strain. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF1xYPSGZSvD98Pv11YxWvg9X9tZy6kW-RtjHqJLnB6ws6x0Sphw3PUGyJXii4caAeV7ms9mTSlIAYmtlk9CY7ZWKfG9fK7_VNSsx7YjNXDPC1_sij53Q0dRruvKGGl_B1IuqTO7R5cRoGwFp9TF0UANOc8Y3g4Dtbp6MQsjbNYXoLGBqIH4RENvf6o4-HGgi4_d2xmWUVia7FAbs) agree that ginger is a popular go-to for calming post-drinking nausea and discomfort.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1_qufAnEnRbgEjNU4Gi5tks39Z-G6K9hERtq6B5vbhMiIScJv4CaqBzWyP7avTJnphs_8P8Q4pDCmYCtY16M9Z0TUf3wRTXfIFEOMQYKfOhkrAn4M840v-oNB4dGty_Hb3W-Flo_06N0I4BqQKX0z2z1AihK1Wc-VGUXWrDEARyU1hx1GGSBTENDyvktvxfpoSXIdA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF1xYPSGZSvD98Pv11YxWvg9X9tZy6kW-RtjHqJLnB6ws6x0Sphw3PUGyJXii4caAeV7ms9mTSlIAYmtlk9CY7ZWKfG9fK7_VNSsx7YjNXDPC1_sij53Q0dRruvKGGl_B1IuqTO7R5cRoGwFp9TF0UANOc8Y3g4Dtbp6MQsjbNYXoLGBqIH4RENvf6o4-HGgi4_d2xmWUVia7FAbs)
